actual_use: Let $N\ge1$ be an integer and put $x_j=\cos(j\pi/N)$ for $j=0,\ldots,N$. The ordering is decreasing: $x_0=1$ and $x_N=-1$. These are the Chebyshev–Gauss–Lobatto nodes; [[thm-chebyshev-multiple-angle-identities]] gives $T_N(x_j)=(-1)^j$. They are distinct because cosine is strictly decreasing on $[0,\pi]$ by [[thm-sine-cosine-signs-monotonicity-and-ranges]].
